rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the signing target sweeps a distribution/output folder
Recognized that multiple projects write to the same output folder
Connected the access-denied error to file ownership or read-only constraints
Explained why the failure is non-deterministic
Suggested separating project outputs or removing redundant Distrib configuration

scenarios.reasoning: Well-targeted, evidence-backed diagnosis that isolates the single failing file, traces it to DistribPathFilesToSign in a shared distrib folder, and gives actionable, correctly-prioritized fixes. Main gap: it explains ACCESS_DENIED purely as a concurrent-lock race and omits the read-only/hard-linked CAS-file explanation that better fits the specific error code, so the mechanism is partially off even though the structural root cause and remedy are right.
scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose why code signing fails with access denied
